page_title: FRO 1-1 LEC | Frosinone v Lecce 03/03/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+9' Nothing more will happen in this game as the referee blows for full time.
90+8' The resulting corner from Emanuele Valeri (Frosinone) comes to nothing.
90+8' Emanuele Valeri (Frosinone) whips in the corner, but one of the defending players gets a head on it and intercepts. The referee and one of his assistants signal for a corner kick to Frosinone.
90+8' Emanuele Valeri (Frosinone) puts a dangerous cross into the box, but the corner is cleared by the first man.

90+8' Kaio Jorge (Frosinone) wins a header inside the box after a cross and steers it goalwards, but Wladimiro Falcone produces a wonderful reflex save. The linesman makes the right call and Frosinone will have a corner.
90+7' Emanuele Valeri (Frosinone) sends a cross into the box, but Wladimiro Falcone comes off his line to gather the ball.
90+7' Emanuele Valeri (Frosinone) puts a cross into the box from the corner but there is no panic from the opposition and they easily clear.
90+6' The resulting corner from Emanuele Valeri (Frosinone) only finds one of the defenders, who heads it out of danger.
90+4' Luca Mazzitelli (Frosinone) unleashes a powerful shot towards goal, but it is bravely blocked by a self-sacrificing defender.
90+4' Joan Gonzalez (Lecce) feels very aggrieved after the referee stops play for a foul that he commits while in possession of the ball.
90+2' Nadir Zortea (Frosinone) tries to slide the ball through to a teammate but it's well blocked by a defender. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Lecce.
90+1' Marco Guida blows his whistle and it's Matias Soule (Frosinone) who is penalised for an offensive foul. Good decision by the referee.
90' We will have 6 min. of added time.
90' Matias Soule (Frosinone) takes the corner but only sends it into a huddle of the defenders and one of them makes a good clearance.
90' Demba Seck (Frosinone) strikes a shot towards goal from the edge of the penalty box, but it flies just wide of the left post.
89' He should have scored! Kaio Jorge (Frosinone) gathered a short pass deep inside the box but took too long to shoot, allowing the defender to make the block.
88' Kaio Jorge (Frosinone) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.
88' Remi Oudin (Lecce) latches on to a cross on the edge of the box and fires a shot at goal, but his effort was blocked by one of the defenders.
87' Eusebio Di Francesco has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Kaio Jorge (Frosinone) replacing Walid Cheddira.
87' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Demba Seck (Frosinone) will replace Reinier.
84' Remi Oudin (Lecce) launches a powerful cross from the corner into the box, but the ball is intercepted by the defender.
82' Matias Soule (Frosinone) launches a cross from the corner, but Wladimiro Falcone is alert to thwart the effort.

81' A bullet header by Roberto Piccoli (Lecce) from inside the box has the power, but goes totally in the wrong direction, yards wide of the left post. The ball goes out of play and Frosinone will have a goal kick.
79' Roberto Piccoli (Lecce) takes a shot from the edge of the box, but it's not a big threat for the goalkeeper as his effort is blocked by a defender.
77' Today's match ends for Francesco Gelli who will be replaced by Fares Ghedjemis (Frosinone).
77' It's time for a substitution. That's the last involvement from Marco Brescianini as he is replaced by Enzo Barrenechea (Frosinone).
76' Roberto D'Aversa decides to make a substitution. Nikola Krstovic will be replaced by Roberto Piccoli (Lecce).
76' Pontus Almqvist goes off the pitch and Alexis Blin (Lecce) comes on.
76' Nikola Krstovic (Lecce) tries to create a chance, but puts too much weight on his pass.
75' Emanuele Valeri (Frosinone) tries to send a pass but it's blocked.
74' Walid Cheddira (Frosinone) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
73' The referee looks satisfied after his VAR review and duly disallows the goal for offside. The Frosinone players look gutted.
72' Attention! Referee Marco Guida straight away wants to review previous situation with VAR, presumably for a possible offside in the build-up.
72' Gooal! No wait, it's been ruled out for offside. Marco Brescianini (Frosinone) disagrees, but the linesman is sure about his call.
71' The resulting corner from Nicola Sansone (Lecce) is cleared by the defence.
70' Marco Brescianini (Frosinone) came close to scoring but should have done much better. His poor attempt from close range ended up in the gloves of Wladimiro Falcone.
69' Nikola Krstovic (Lecce) appears to handle the ball in the box, but the ref turns down the penalty appeals and waves play on!
67' Substitution. Remi Oudin (Lecce) in, Hamza Rafia out.
67' Roberto D'Aversa prepares a substitution. Lameck Banda is replaced by Nicola Sansone (Lecce).
63' Francesco Gelli (Frosinone) fires a rebound from mid-range onto the bar!
62' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Mohamed Kaba trots off the pitch and is replaced by Joan Gonzalez (Lecce).
61' Michele Cerofolini (Frosinone) scores an unfortunate own goal after deflecting the ball into his own net!
61' Nikola Krstovic (Lecce) fails to convert the penalty kick! His effort hits the left post.
61' Nikola Krstovic (Lecce) is going to take the penalty!
60' Wait! The referee has seen an infringement and Lecce will have to take the penalty again!
58' Michele Cerofolini anticipates the direction of the penalty by Hamza Rafia (Lecce). He attempted to put the ball into the bottom right corner, but the goalkeeper was there in time to deny him.
58' Hamza Rafia (Lecce) will take the responsibility and he is already preparing the ball.
57' Marco Guida blows his whistle and signals a foul after Michele Cerofolini (Frosinone) brought his opponent down. PENALTY to Lecce! Great chance to score.
55' Pontus Almqvist (Lecce) sees a yellow card from Marco Guida after he sent one of the opposing players to the ground.
53' Lameck Banda (Lecce) takes the corner but fails to find any of his teammates.
53' Nikola Krstovic (Lecce) sends a pass into the box, but his attempt is thwarted and cleared. Lecce win a corner.
51' Nikola Krstovic (Lecce) is flagged for offside.
49' Walid Cheddira (Frosinone) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.
48' Nadir Zortea (Frosinone) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Wladimiro Falcone intercepts the ball.
46' Pontus Almqvist (Lecce) finds himself beyond the last defender, but the game is stopped by the referee after the linesman signals for offside.
46' The second half has just started.
45+4' Marco Guida has ended the first half by blowing the whistle.
45+2' 1 - 0 Goal! Walid Cheddira (Frosinone) fires the rebound into the roof of the net after the ball breaks to him in the box. The score is 1:0.
45+1' A fine lofted pass into the box, sent by Luca Mazzitelli (Frosinone), is intercepted by the opposition's defence.
45' The fourth official shows 2 min. of added time.
44' Reinier (Frosinone) gets a yellow card. The referee Marco Guida made the right call.
44' Emanuele Valeri (Frosinone) flights in the cross, but the defender is alert and clears to safety.
42' Frosinone fail to score from a corner as Wladimiro Falcone (Lecce) leaps to collect the ball.

42' Matias Soule (Frosinone) strikes the ball towards goal, but it fails to reach the target after being well blocked by one of the defenders. The linesman points to the corner flag, Frosinone are going to take it.
40' Emanuele Valeri (Frosinone) swings in a cross, but the ball is cleared to safety by one of the defending players.
40' Mohamed Kaba (Lecce) holds his opponent to prevent him from getting the ball and the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
38' A pass by Reinier (Frosinone) ends up in no man's land, and the attacking effort comes to an end.
37' Reinier (Frosinone) picks up the ball, dribbles to the edge of the penalty area and unleashes a brilliant shot, but is thwarted by a decent save from Wladimiro Falcone.
35' Marco Brescianini (Frosinone) delivers a long ball, but it lacks enough power to reach his teammates and is intercepted by one of the defenders.
34' Lameck Banda (Lecce) steps up to take the corner, but the ball just sails in among the defenders.
33' Hamza Rafia (Lecce) launches the ball from the resulting corner, but one of the defenders is first to the ball and deals with the threat.

32' Emanuele Valeri (Frosinone) picks up a rebound, moves into space and fires a shot at goal from long range that rises sharply and curls well wide of the right post. The ball goes out of play and Lecce will have a goal kick.
32' Francesco Gelli (Frosinone) sends a wonderful cross from the corner kick. However, the defence works perfectly to clear the ball and avert the threat.
32' Francesco Gelli (Frosinone) takes the corner but it's cleared. The ball is out of play. Frosinone will have a chance to score from a corner.
31' A cross into the box from Francesco Gelli (Frosinone) is cleared. The ball goes out of play and Frosinone have been awarded a corner kick.

30' Pontus Almqvist (Lecce) meets a delivery on the edge of the penalty area and shoots towards to the bottom left corner. He didn't put enough power into the effort, though, and Michele Cerofolini pulls off an easy save.
28' The ball is cleared after Lameck Banda (Lecce) attempted to dribble past an opposing player.
27' Hamza Rafia (Lecce) takes the corner but fails to find any of his teammates. The ball is easily cleared out of danger.

27' Nikola Krstovic (Lecce) runs onto a loose pass inside the box and releases a tremendous shot towards the bottom right corner. However, Michele Cerofolini anticipates the shot and makes a brilliant save. The ball goes out of play. Lecce are awarded a corner kick.
27' The corner kick from Hamza Rafia (Lecce) is headed out of the penalty area by one of the defenders.

26' Hamza Rafia (Lecce) floats the ball in from the corner but it's intercepted. The referee and his assistant both point at the corner flag. Lecce will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
23' Lameck Banda (Lecce) unleashes a shot, but his effort is poor and floats high over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Frosinone.
22' Reinier (Frosinone) tackles a bit over-zealously and Marco Guida blows for a foul.
20' Francesco Gelli (Frosinone) takes the corner which is cleared by the opposition's defence.
18' Walid Cheddira (Frosinone) skips past his man but can't keep the ball in play. The ball goes out of play and Lecce will have a goal kick.
18' Nikola Krstovic (Lecce) did his best to latch on to a crossfield pass, but it was too long and it goes out of play. The ball is out of play. Frosinone will take a throw-in.
16' Marco Brescianini (Frosinone) is caught offside!
15' Matias Soule (Frosinone) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.
14' Lameck Banda (Lecce) shoots from the edge of the penalty area. The ball travels towards the crossbar, but Michele Cerofolini easily deals with the threat.
13' Emanuele Valeri (Frosinone) serves up a nice cross, but Wladimiro Falcone punches the ball away.
12' Hamza Rafia (Lecce) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Michele Cerofolini, who smothers the ball.
11' Nikola Krstovic (Lecce) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away. The linesman signals a throw-in for Lecce.
10' The resulting set piece, sent into the penalty area by Hamza Rafia (Lecce), was easily dealt with by one of the defenders.
10' Rough tackle by Luca Mazzitelli (Frosinone). The referee blows his whistle for a foul.
8' Federico Baschirotto (Lecce) sends a long ball in, but Michele Cerofolini comfortably gathers the ball.
6' Simone Romagnoli (Frosinone) does his best to latch onto a cross into the box, but he can't get to the ball. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Lecce.
5' Frosinone force a corner. They send men into the box.

5' Walid Cheddira (Frosinone) meets a pass on the edge of the penalty area and shoots towards the bottom right corner. He didn't put enough power into the effort, though, and Wladimiro Falcone pulls off an easy save. Frosinone force a corner. They send men into the box.
4' Abdou Harroui has picked up an injury and is replaced by Reinier (Frosinone).
4' Eusebio Di Francesco is stunned as referee Marco Guida shows him a yellow card. What was that for?
3' Abdou Harroui (Frosinone) looks like he won’t be able to continue.
2' Abdou Harroui (Frosinone) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
1' The referee blows his whistle and we are underway.
The players are out at last! Lecce will take the kick-off.
Marco Guida is introduced as the referee for today's match.
